beats.beat: A B Infrabuild operates in two segments: creation of infrastructure and operating a ready-mix concrete (RMC) plant.
Its infrastructure work covers railway platforms, station buildings, bridge types (beam, cantilever, arch, suspension, cable-stayed, truss), and bituminous and concrete roads.
Contracts are won through a tender process: the client floats a tender, a pre-bid meeting is held, the lowest quote gets the work, and a performance guarantee must be deposited.

Major clients include Western Railways, Central Railways, MRVCL, MCGM, MMRDA, Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation, and several private firms. Western Railway alone contributed 52% of the order book.
The company’s operations are concentrated in Mumbai and Maharashtra, with a stated aim to consolidate its position in the state.
The company touts its long-standing client relationships (Western Railway since 2006), modern techniques like box pushing, and substantial investment in machinery at its Kashimira facility.

business.heading: What the company does
business.purpose: Explain its two business segments, how it wins contracts, its main products, clients, and operations.

beats.beat: Revenue from operations declined from ₹8,661.35 lakhs in FY2014 to ₹6,053.05 lakhs in FY2018, a drop of about 30% over five years.
Net profit after adjustments was erratic: ₹95.95 lakhs in FY2014, dropped to ₹15.86 lakhs in FY2017, then jumped to ₹314.66 lakhs in FY2018.
Profit before interest, depreciation and tax (EBITDA) ranged from ₹676.19 lakhs (FY2017) to ₹945.78 lakhs (FY2015); the most recent year (FY2018) was ₹928.80 lakhs.
Short term borrowings rose steadily from ₹3,082.27 lakhs (FY2014) to ₹3,537.35 lakhs (FY2018). Long term borrowings declined sharply after FY2016.
The company reported negative cash flows in recent financial years, which the filing warns could impact business if sustained.
Trade receivables collection risk is flagged, and the company had ₹405.02 lakhs in unsecured loans repayable on demand as of March 31, 2018.

financials.heading: Financial performance and position
financials.purpose: Present the restated financials across all five reported years, including revenue, PAT, EBITDA, debt, and cash flow.

beats.beat: The sole promoter is Amit Bholanath Mishra, who holds 74,95,476 equity shares — 90.949% of the pre-issue capital.
Key management personnel include CFO Anchal Pachori (Chartered Accountant, age 28) and Company Secretary Mohit Soni (ACS, age 26).
Related party transactions: loans taken from KMP/board of ₹68.4 lakhs in FY2018, director remuneration of ₹57.7 lakhs, and payables outstanding to related parties of ₹324.3 lakhs.
No criminal cases have been filed against any director, and none appear on RBI’s list of wilful defaulters.
Two companies promoted by the promoter — Al-Noor Chickens Private Limited and A B Magma Automobiles Private Limited — were struck off by ROC in 2016 due to non-operation.

beats.beat: A B Infrabuild operates in the infrastructure construction sector, which is highly fragmented and working-capital intensive, contributing roughly 8% to India’s GDP.
The filing cites government programs like the 100 Smart Cities Mission, AMRUT, Make in India, and eased FDI norms as growth drivers.
It notes India’s requirement of ₹50 trillion in infrastructure investment by 2022 and a logistics sector CAGR of 10.5% from 2017 to 2020.
Competition comes from both organized and unorganized players.
Headwinds acknowledged include slow pace of government projects, working capital crunch, and changes in government policies.

industry.heading: Market and industry
industry.purpose: Describe the infrastructure construction industry, its size, growth drivers, and the competition A B Infrabuild faces.

beats.beat: A B Infrabuild Limited is a Mumbai-based infrastructure construction company that also operates a ready-mix concrete plant. It primarily works on government contracts through a bidding process.
This SME IPO aims to raise up to ₹4.43 crore (assuming ₹10 face value) through a fresh issue of 44.28 lakh shares.
The funds are earmarked for working capital and general corporate purposes.

intro.purpose: Orient the reader: who A B Infrabuild is, what it does, what it is raising and why it matters.

beats.beat: The issue consists solely of a fresh issue of 44,28,000 equity shares of ₹10 each at a price to be determined. There is no offer for sale.
The lead manager to the issue is Mark Corporate Advisors Private Limited.
Registrar is Bigshare Services Private Limited.

The company intends to use ₹1,130 lakhs of the net proceeds to meet working capital requirements, with the remainder for general corporate purposes. The exact allocation for general corporate purposes is not disclosed.
There is no independent agency appointed to appraise the project, and no monitoring agency has been appointed; fund deployment will be monitored by the Audit Committee.

offer.heading: The offer and its proceeds
offer.purpose: Detail the issue structure, lead manager, use of funds, and any OFS.

beats.beat: Customer concentration: Indian Railways (Western Railway) contributed 57% of revenue in FY2018. Loss of this customer would cause a significant revenue drop.
Dependence on government contracts: business relies on winning bids from government departments. Failure to win new contracts or delays in award could hurt finances.
Negative cash flows in recent years: the filing warns that sustained negative cash flow could harm business, financial condition and results.
Unsecured loans of ₹405.02 lakhs repayable on demand as of March 2018. Any demand for repayment could strain cash flow.
Promoter’s two earlier companies were struck off by ROC for non-operation, raising governance concerns.

risks.heading: Material risks
risks.purpose: Identify the top specific risks from the filing, not generic IPO boilerplate.

beats.beat: The DRHP provides a comparison with one peer company, but does not name the peer. Key ratios for the company: EPS (FY2018) ₹28.14, P/E (FY2018) 12.59, RoNW (most recent) 12.39%. The peer’s EPS is ₹44.71 and RoNW is 12.39%.
The issue price is to be determined and will be justified by the company in consultation with the lead manager based on these ratios.
Without the peer’s identity or the issue price, an implied price range cannot be computed from this data alone.
